problem.text: With the default return_probs=False and return_top_tokens=0, Job.receive_logits skipped every assignment to its optional outputs, then referenced them at return.

reasoning.text: Initialize all three optional outputs to None before testing the reporting options. Enabled branches overwrite only the requested outputs; removing their else assignments is safe because the new initialization supplies those defaults.

impact.text: Removes the disabled-options unbound-local failure without changing the four-value return order or enabled probability calculations.

source_notes.text: The immediate parent's entry was read in full. It records both the disabled-options failure and a separate mismatch between reported probabilities and the final sampling distribution.

Issue #12, “Qwen2.5 Coder 0.5B Instruct | ValueError: Unsupported type in stop_conditions,” reports constructor validation failure and discusses using chatml instead of llama3 mode. Its connection here is only an inferred shared-file relationship: its traceback names job.py, whereas this patch changes receive_logits, not constructor validation.

limitations: The executed check transcribed Python assignment branches with string stand-ins; it did not execute Job, PyTorch operations, sampling or GPU generation.
End-to-end generation success and performance were not measured.

chapters.title: Initialize optional sampling outputs on every return path

claims.text: Sampling still happens first. Probability softmax runs only when return_probs is enabled or return_top_tokens is positive; zero disables top-token reporting. The patch adds no tensor computation to the disabled path.

A whole-parent search found one active direct caller, Generator.iterate_gen, and one commented threading alternative. The active caller unpacks all four values and forwards them to receive_sample, whose probability-buffer appends are guarded by the same reporting options. None therefore fits the existing disabled-output consumer contract.

A scalar branch transcription tested all four enabled/disabled combinations before and after the edit. Only the old both-disabled case raised UnboundLocalError; the new case returned the token plus three None values. The other three combinations retained identical stand-in outputs.

Source comparison removes the parent's recorded initialization defect but carries over its probability-reporting mismatch: the patch leaves the post-sampling softmax of logits unchanged rather than obtaining the sampler's transformed distribution.

findings.description: Optional diagnostics still need not represent the documented final sampling probabilities.
findings.trigger: Enable probability or top-token reporting with CustomSampler while supplying allowed_tokens or blocked_tokens that exclude a token with finite input logits.
findings.expected_behavior: Final sampling probabilities reflect the constraints, excluding forbidden candidates.
findings.actual_behavior: CustomSampler clones logits before applying these constraints. Job.receive_logits subsequently normalizes its original logits, so excluded tokens retain reported probability and can appear in top-token output. The sole active direct caller forwards those diagnostics unchanged into receive_sample's streaming buffers.

verification.description: Compared the final-probability documentation, cloned constraint masks, unchanged diagnostic calculation and direct caller's forwarding.
verification.limits: No tensor execution; this observation concerns the inspected CustomSampler path, not every external sampler.

annotation.summary: Fixes uninitialized optional outputs when probability reporting is disabled; enabled diagnostics and their inherited distribution mismatch remain unchanged.
